subject: Catalyst Bank SIG: dataflow inventory & encryption substantiation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalystbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Catalyst Bank Security Team <security@catalystbank.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: Dataflow inventory & encryption substantiation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our SIG review we need a concise mapping of Redwood's dataflows that touch or persist customer data, plus encryption substantiation for data at-rest and in-transit. Specifically our reviewers asked for: 

- A dataflow inventory (diagram + brief list) showing where tokens, user prompts, and embeddings may be processed/stored.
- Encryption proof: KMS key types & key rotation cadence, sample KMS audit entries, and where envelope encryption is applied.
- Any exceptions or customer-configurable options (VPC/private deployment, Bring-Your-Own-KMS).

Ideal: a single PDF dataflow diagram and a short bundle of logs/configs we can review (redacted). Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Information Security Manager
Catalyst Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalystbank.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG: Dataflow inventory & encryption substantiation

Hi Liam,

Thanks — we can absolutely provide that. High-level plan and ETA: 

1) Dataflow inventory: we'll deliver a single-page diagram + a short CSV inventory mapping each processing component (API gateway, inference runtime, batch jobs, audit store) to data types and retention. ETA: 72 hours.
2) Encryption substantiation: KMS key types (AWS KMS + customer-managed HSM where applicable), rotation cadence, and a redacted sample of KMS audit entries. ETA: 5 business days for audit snippets (we'll redact account IDs).
3) Exceptions & options: we'll include notes about Private deployment options (BYOK) and network isolation.

I'll own delivery. Looping in Priyom and Karthik to pull the artifacts and confirm redaction.

Deliverables (expected): redwood_dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, kms-rotation-schedule.csv, sample-audit-log-snippet.txt, and a one-page cover note describing the mapping to SIG control IDs.

If you need a short walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-minute call after we share the materials.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: SIG: Dataflow inventory & encryption substantiation

Marissa / Karthik —

I'll coordinate artifacts. Quick notes for scoping the evidence package: 

- Dataflow diagram: I'll take v2 of the diagram and annotate processing zones (hosted API, dedicated GPU pool, private deployment). I'll produce the CSV inventory with the following columns: component, data_type, retention_policy, storage_location, relevant_SIG_IDs.

- KMS evidence: Mina, can you extract a 30-day sample of KMS audit entries showing key creation, rotate, decrypt requests (redacted), plus the current rotation schedule? Please export as kms-rotation-schedule.csv and redact account identifiers.

- Sample audit log: we'll include a snippet (sample-audit-log-snippet.txt) showing envelope encryption usage in the storage layer. Keep PII out of logs.

Timeline: I can turn the inventory + diagram preliminary into a Drive link by 2027-07-04 COB. Mina to aim for KMS samples by 2027-07-06.

PRIYOM
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

> On Jul 1, 2027, at 10:05 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > Deliverables (expected): redwood_dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, kms-rotation-schedule.csv, sample-audit-log-snippet.txt...

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalystbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG: Dataflow inventory & encryption substantiation

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and timeline. The proposed artifacts look good; we'll review the Drive bundle once you share. A couple of follow-ups from our reviewers: 

- For the KMS sample, can you include a line that shows source IPs redacted but the operation type (CreateKey/Rotate/Encrypt/Decrypt) and timestamp? That helps auditors confirm lifecycle coverage.
- For the dataflow inventory CSV, please include a column for "customer_configurable" (yes/no) so we can quickly filter BYOK-capable components.
- If possible, include a one-line statement about how you handle ephemeral KV cache data in the inference runtime (in-memory only? persisted?).

We may request a short call the week of Jul 12 if we have questions after review. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Liam
Information Security Manager
Catalyst Bank

> On Jul 2, 2027, at 2:30 PM, Priyom Das wrote:
> > Timeline: I can turn the inventory + diagram preliminary into a Drive link by 2027-07-04 COB. Mina to aim for KMS samples by 2027-07-06.
